name: computer-use
description: LOKI drives this computer's desktop (screenshots, mouse, keyboard) for apps without an API: the accessibility tree first (Windows UI Automation, macOS Accessibility), vision only when that fails. You approve each app once; Ctrl+Alt+Esc or the mouse in the top-left corner stops it at once; never in background jobs unless you allow it; every action is logged.
license: LOKI's own code (control-type list from Windows-MCP, MIT)
install: Windows: Install (pip comtypes) for the accessibility tree. macOS: System Settings > Privacy & Security > Accessibility and Screen Recording: allow the app that runs LOKI.
notice: This lets LOKI click and type on your real desktop. It asks before it touches each app; the kill switch is Ctrl+Alt+Esc.
